name: Speedy
description: Speedy delivery for shops in Bulgaria: live prices from Speedy's API to an address or to a Speedy office, office choice at checkout, the chosen office on the order, cash-on-delivery fees in the price, and waybills (PDF) from the admin.

settings.label: API username
settings.help: The API user Speedy gives with your contract (test accounts on request from Speedy).

settings.label: API password
settings.help: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

settings.label: Service
settings.help: Speedy service id from your contract, e.g. 505 (standard 24 hours).

settings.label: Drop-off office id
settings.help: When you hand parcels in at a Speedy office. Empty: Speedy uses your contract address.

author: PN Scripts
